layers.name: room
layers.prompt: Edit the reference into a clean background plate for a 2.5D game. Preserve warm painterly cinematic wooden study, centered blue night window, bookshelves, ivy, map, sleeping cat on right sideboard. REMOVE the entire foreground poker table, cup, near lantern, notebook and large foreground plant. Reconstruct the lower room behind them, with dark wooden floor and a single centered empty wicker chair at the far side, no table anywhere. Full portrait 9:16 composition, room fills canvas edge to edge, no UI, no text, no people. Keep recognizable architecture and lighting of reference. This plate will be covered by a separate table sprite in its lower two thirds.

layers.name: table
layers.prompt: Extract and reconstruct ONLY the large teal felt oval poker table from this reference as a production game sprite. Portrait 9:16 canvas. Preserve original perspective: far curved wood rim at approximately 34 percent image height, teal patterned felt across entire wide middle, curved front golden wooden rim at approximately 90 percent height, dark wooden apron to bottom edge. Table extends past both left and right canvas edges. Remove ALL room/background above far rim to actual transparent alpha. Remove cup, lantern, notebook, plants, cat and ALL objects from table; reconstruct uninterrupted felt and rim where they were. No room, no text, no UI, no additional shadow outside silhouette. Top third fully transparent, table lower two thirds. Painterly warm gold wood and deep teal fabric, matching reference.

layers.name: near-left
layers.prompt: Create an isolated foreground left-edge prop cluster matching the reference painterly warm study: one ivory botanical tea cup full of amber tea on a round wooden coaster, with a softly out of focus leafy potted plant lower left. Transparent background. Tall narrow composition, approximately 1:2 aspect ratio. Cup toward upper part, plant below; cluster hugs LEFT edge; RIGHT half completely transparent. Complete silhouettes, no table or room or chairs, no typography. Warm lantern light from the right. This is a foreground parallax sprite for the left edge of a portrait game screen; keep middle of screen unobstructed.

layers.name: near-right
layers.prompt: Create an isolated foreground right-edge prop cluster matching the reference painterly warm study: glowing antique brass lantern above a brown leather journal with gold compass embossing. Transparent background. Tall narrow composition approximately 1:2 aspect ratio. Lantern in upper half, journal angled slightly in lower half; cluster hugs RIGHT edge, LEFT half completely transparent. Complete silhouettes, no table or room or chairs, no text. Warm gold light.
